digest.component_or_area: LLM framework structured output and prompt cache
propositions: Structured-output one-operation path with prompt caching must be verified live on both Anthropic direct and Bedrock providers to confirm cache write and read counts
Two sequential calls over identical byte-aligned system prefix must demonstrate cache hit: first call writes prefix to cache, second call reads it back
Usage accounting (input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, requests) reported by runner must match documented contract in framework documentation
Complete-vs-omit branch behavior in wire projection must be directly observable and recorded for well-formed responses on each provider
Mixed-provider fallback chains collapse cache behavior to none due to incompatible cache keys between providers
